description: This PHP class 'LDAPAuthenticationPluginConfiguration' implements configuration for an LDAP authentication plugin within the OrangeHRM system. It handles setting up LDAP logging, conditionally adds LDAP authentication provider, registers LDAP sync commands, and schedules LDAP sync jobs based on settings.

classes.name: LDAPAuthenticationPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Configures LDAP authentication, logging, command registration, and scheduling within the OrangeHRM plugin system.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up LDAP logger and conditionally adds LDAP provider if enabled in settings.

methods.name: registerCommands
methods.description: Registers LDAP sync command with the console.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules LDAP user sync jobs based on the configured sync interval.
